title: World generation (town and industry counts and spacing per map size)

sizes.description: Exactly one entry per map size: small (128x128), medium (256x256), large (512x512).

townSpacing.description: Minimum Chebyshev distance between town anchors, in tiles.

industrySpacing.description: Minimum Chebyshev distance between industry anchors, in tiles (at least 3 so a station cannot attach to two sites).

industries.description: Industries to place, in placement order. Level, inputs and outputs come from industries.json.

count.description: Exact number of instances to place.

maxProducerDistance.description: Inclusive maximum Chebyshev distance to a lower-level producer of each input; 0 for a primary industry, positive otherwise.
